locale_policy: Copy the eight existing source locale slots to slots 0-7 of the 16-slot target. Slots 8-15 remain empty. Source esES is slot 6; fall back to the original enUS bytes only if empty. No translations are authored.
allocation_scope: Candidate-only reservation. Recheck effective DBC, DEV SQL and tracked SQL on every build. Not a deployment manifest.
limits: Map0 and its native WDT are inputs to the separate terrain work; this tool emits neither Map.dbc nor WDT.
Area remaps must also be applied to selected MCNK cells and any later SQL/content references; no terrain or SQL is installed here.

The 13 inherited root4772/nameSet1 WMO keys are native WotLK metadata. They remain byteexact, pointing to native area3881, and are excluded from the port. Models using those keys need a separately coordinated geometry/key remap.

Only custom WMO roots6000-6002 are added. Final assets validation checks placed MOHD root/MODF nameSet/MOGP group against available row metadata; groups without source metadata do not acquire invented rows. In-game routing remains untested.
WorldMapArea bounds and file tokens are retained from Turtle; interface map artwork, overlays, minimap, exploration gameplay and in-game behavior are not validated.
Sound, music, ambience and lighting references are copied, not ported or proven semantically equivalent to WotLK resources.
Client WMOAreaTable is absent from regular custom patches; its baseline is resolved from the stock locale archive chain. Server baseline is independent. HD is outside scope.
